title: KOSPI Close November 27, 2026: Rises 4.34% to 4,915.68, KOSDAQ +8.13%
content:
KOSPI closed at 4,915.68, up 4.34%, and KOSDAQ closed at 708.99, up 8.13% and back above 700, as foreigners bought more than 1 trillion won of KOSPI shares with U.S. markets closed for Thanksgiving. A buy sidecar was triggered on KOSDAQ, and chip-plant robot makers, telecom equipment, security, biotech and battery stocks all rose.

IndexCloseChange
KOSPI4,915.68+4.34%
KOSDAQ708.99+8.13%

Our read: KOSDAQ led, not the chip giants

This rebound looks different from the Nov 24 one. On Nov 24, KOSPI (+6.32%) beat KOSDAQ (+4.79%) on a U.S. chip rally. Today, with no U.S. session to follow, KOSDAQ rose 8.13%, nearly twice KOSPI's 4.34%, and Samsung Electronics (+4.20%) and SK hynix (+4.75%) rose only about as much as the index. The bigger moves were in smaller growth names: 14 of the biotech stocks listed below rose between 13% and 27%. KOSDAQ opened at 664.52 and that was also its low for the day, so it never traded below the opening level. KOSPI, at 4,915.68, is still below the 5,006.03 close of Nov 24.

1. Broad rebound with foreign and institutional buying

KOSPI opened at 4,728.80 (+0.37%) and rose as high as 4,922.94 (+4.49%) before closing at 4,915.68. KOSDAQ opened at 664.52 (+1.34%), reached 710.90 (+8.42%) and closed at 708.99.

On KOSPI, foreigners net bought about 1.13 trillion won and institutions about 236 billion won, while individuals net sold about 1.78 trillion won (provisional). On KOSDAQ, institutions net bought about 587 billion won and foreigners about 302 billion won, while individuals net sold about 885 billion won.

2. Robots for chip plants — AMR adoption

Korean coverage said Samsung Electronics and SK hynix plan to expand use of autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) in new chip fabs, designing wider logistics aisles from the start. Overhead hoist transport systems already move wafers; AMRs would take over parts and consumables delivery now partly done by hand. Genics Robotics and Clobot hit the upper limit. The plan was reported and not independently confirmed.

Quick FAQ

How did KOSPI and KOSDAQ close on Nov 27?
KOSPI closed at 4,915.68 (+4.34%) and KOSDAQ at 708.99 (+8.13%), back above 700.

Why did Korean stocks rebound?
Dip buying after the recent plunge while U.S. markets were closed for Thanksgiving, with foreigners net buying about 1.13 trillion won on KOSPI.

Which stocks hit the upper limit?
Genics Robotics and Clobot, both tied to robots for chip plants, closed near +30%.

This brief is our own summary based on same-day Korean market coverage and Daum Finance closing data; it is not a translation and not investment advice. See our Disclaimer and evidence labels.
